title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed
tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A 10-second audio file was delivered with no reported vocals, though its lo-fi hip-hop character and warm, relaxed mood cannot be verified from the transcription.

must_haves.item: One playable music audio file is delivered.
must_haves.why: lofi_bed_10s.wav is provided with readable duration and peak-level metadata.

must_haves.item: The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
must_haves.why: The transcription does not describe the beat or texture, and the audio cannot be heard.

must_haves.item: The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
must_haves.why: Musical mood cannot be determined from the supplied metadata and transcription.

must_haves.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcription reports no clear speech or vocal content and explicitly excludes stray fragments as speech.
